items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...you know the band he had in the 60s with Joe Zawinul...

ctx.x: Because he played for that show and talks about it quite a bit.

All right. I’ll be giving Roy a call. I didn’t know that until a while ago, someone else told me that, I was very fascinated by that. But you know the band he had in the 60s with Joe Zawinul and I mean that’s it.
We have some of those CDs in — both Julieann, my wife and I, in our cars we have Cannonball CDs in both our cars right now from that era. So wherever we’re going we can always get right to it.
